Walk through the pipeline in order. NFC and Unicode L/M filtering retain Telugu letters and combining marks. Normalization removes punctuation, digits and URLs from classifier text and standardizes selected romanized spellings. It keeps stopwords. The implementation separately extracts quantities from the original query for calculations. TF-IDF word features use unigrams and bigrams; character features use char_wb n-grams of length 2 to 5. Classification predicts a topic, and entity/routing rules then guide the answer. The authored benchmark reports generalization after model selection

Explain why nine experiments exist: three classifiers times three feature families. Group-aware five-fold CV uses original training text with fold-local TF-IDF. Synthetic coverage enters final model fitting, so CV and validation use different training regimes. Validation macro-F1 selects the winner, with accuracy as a tie-break. The saved selection is Logistic Regression with word features. The 319-query challenge is for reporting and must not retrospectively choose a different model. The character and combined models improve challenge scores, which provides a future research direction. Weather uses Open-Meteo geocoding and the requested dated daily forecasts. Tomorrow uses the next day, and a three-day request uses three explicit dates including today. Missing location triggers a district selector. Mandi lookup uses the configured data.gov.in adapter and preserves commodity, market, reporting date and INR/quintal; older reports never become today's price. Unspecified chilli prompts dry/green clarification. Hanumakonda soil testing, PM-KISAN status, Rythu Bharosa forms and FARMS hiring use official public guidance and links. The assistant cannot inspect private payment status or confirm live equipment availability. External-service verification in regression tests uses explicit fixtures, not claims of observed current prices or weather. elements.name: Future work: field validation and stronger la

runs.text: Future work: field validation and stronger language-transfer models

Conclude that the project demonstrates a working classical NLP assistant for Telugu-English agricultural queries. The selected model's stored 319-query raw accuracy is 79.00%, and its macro-F1 is 80.02%. Saved routing rules improve that challenge accuracy to 83.39%, but the latest question-handling expansion has not been included in that stored metric. Cross-script transfer remains weak in macro-F1 and uses a separate combined-feature model. Workbook provenance and template effects limit external validity. Future work should collect consented real farmer questions, expand expert-reviewed local advice and validate transfer across scripts. Do not claim the system diagnoses diseases or answers every possible question. runs.text: Functional checks use explicit API fixtures. Field performance requires separate validation.

The current reports record 118 pytest checks, 43 question-flow browser checks, 28 practical-guidance browser checks and 21 remaining chart/browser checks. The browser sum is 92; these are functional checks with explicit external-service fixtures, not a field accuracy measure. For viva: TF-IDF measures term importance; word/character features address different spelling variation. Macro-F1 averages class-wise F1 equally. Validation selected the model; the authored challenge was not used to pick it. ML predicts intent while rules/entities supply context and the knowledge layer supplies reviewed advice.
